title: Français 2971
contents: A Venetian diplomatic report about the king’s letters, an affront involving Milan, and warnings of a conspiracy; its closing fragment mentions England.
fields: 28 symbols, 22 letter signs, 2 in nomenclature, 4 unidentified
Interlinear plaintext on the same page, f32r. ·

excerpt: … **lettres du Roy à Seigneurie n’eussent sceu arriuer à meilleur poinct, aultant qu’elle** [e]**stoit mal contente apres la demonstration qu’elle auoit faicte pour le roi**…
translation: … letters from the king to the Signoria could not have arrived at a better moment, given that it was displeased after the show of support it had made for the king …
